name: Vivaldi 2-4 GHz: end-fire limits for 10 dBi
description: How long must an end-fire antenna be for 10 dBi between 2 and 4 GHz (Hansen-Woodyard and ordinary end-fire limits), and from which frequency can boards of 150, 206 and 260 mm reach it. Add the 'Reproduce an antenna study package' node to check and re-run an external package, or the 'Open Vivaldi study (EMerge)' node to run the open model.
